allow_instructions: Read-only filesystem commands are safe: listing, reading, stat, search (dir, ls, type, cat, Get-Content, findstr, grep, rg, git status, git diff, git log).
Test runners, linters, type checks and formatters are safe: pytest, unittest, npm test, tsc --noEmit.
Git read commands are safe: status, diff, log, show, branch, remote, fetch.
Local dev server start/stop via project scripts is safe (launch_server.py / stop_server.py).
The project's own Python environment (.venv) commands are safe.
block_instructions: Destructive commands require approval: rm, del, rmdir, Remove-Item, git reset --hard, git clean -fd, git push --force, DROP TABLE.
Any command writing to .env, secrets, or credential files requires approval.
Global package installation (npm install -g, pip install outside a venv) requires approval.
Database schema migrations or destructive SQL require approval.
Commands that modify system-wide settings (registry, services, firewall) require approval.
